name: Doom Tasks
summary: A task-first browser extension that redirects distracting browsing back to the page you need until your tasks are complete.

name: Voidension
summary: A configurable Go load balancer with server availability checks, request queuing, and retries with exponential backoff.

name: React Easing Scroll
summary: A React hook for smooth in-page navigation, with more than 30 easing functions and configurable animation timing.

name: MFCT

name: Textbook RSA cryptanalysis

name: Chokidaar
